title: AI Cost Governance: The New Mandate for Future CFOs
tagline: Preparing Business Students for the AI-Powered Economy
author: Dr. Debasis Pahi
copyright: Created and Copyright by Dr. Debasis Pahi
key_facts: Nearly 80% of North American CFOs have a formal role in AI decisions (Deloitte Q3 2026)
Only 47% monitor AI usage costs in near real time
60% expect AI costs and complexity to rise substantially through 2027
Only 3% actively reducing finance headcount due to AI; 60% redeploying staff (Datarails)
Only 7% of finance functions fully ready for enterprise AI
philosophy: AI generates. DATA informs. FINANCE measures. ACCOUNTING verifies. HUMAN JUDGMENT decides.
